author: SkepticalHarry
quote: GTA 6 feels like an exercise in excessive hype and what do we get for the first 5 hours?. Chores and the same modern day ideology being pushed through the veins of society. GTA is supposed to be the safe haven for this where all gamers can go and do whatever they want. This isnt the case, and the player is locked in through the developers narrative. This was never the case with these games, and these people just cant help themselves. All the other GTAs were an 8-10, and this one doesnt do justice at all and im giving a negative review because its your same old ideolog injection used as another propaganda source in entertainment. I dont stand for it, and I hope these writers and developers lose their job for the next game. Its unfortunate their main goal was to sell as many preoders they could because they knew there was gonna be no physical disc, on top of alot of blowback where most gamers wouldnt be able to refund. This was another hit to the classic audience of gamers, the main audience who pay and paved the way for new installments. Its a slap in the face. Laugh now cause you made your money back from preorders but dont count on your next game doing the same.

author: SkepticalHarry
quote: Had a blast with this one. Dark gritty masterclass, and Id say trumps all of the experiences Id had with this franchise to date. The combat, enemy type and variation is all a blast and its hard to beat. Tempo is perfect, story is there, although not the best, I still enjoyed the protagonist and adventure. Def one to be remember and gonna play a second playthrough on the harder difficulty with my wife.

author: SkepticalHarry
quote: Aside from graphical fidelity at 30fps, this game achieves on digital assets and world building as always. Its RDR2 style which can always hold true. Of the positives this is about it and why I score a 3 for worldbuilding and obvious expensive assets and cinematics which a gamer like myself appreciates. After 22 hours in, I can say Im bored, im choreless, and after taking 2 days off from work I can say Im super displeased with how this game plays. Its nothing like the GTA I remember. I feel like my player is locked and needs to be jailbroken. MY* actions are tamed due to developer bias like we see with alot of modern day games. Rockstar was a pillar now effected. Gameplay is ok but even on the 2026 calender, there are games that wipe this combat off the map. World stands a shot but even at that Crimson Desert has just as good world building and better action at that. This is a huge downgrade from the prized series and its sad to see. This game is so tame to how it used to be and my nostalgia got slapped in the face. I dont know if other players feel this way, but I wanted to give the game at least 20 hours before I made my review.

author: SkepticalHarry
quote: After my second playthrough on hard mode, this has become one of, if not my favorite short story scifi action adventure game of all time. In terms of scifi, the only game in my books that wins is SOMA. Different games but thats the parallel I can as comparison. This game has a great story between two great protagonists, Hugh and Diana. Hugh is a space supersoldier from earth who carries out details and objective who stumbles on a crumbling landscape on the moon, which has turned into a 3D technology site that has been contaminated by virus. Deadly in fact and could jeapordize earth. Diana is a tip of the sphere AI who was made special by the Founder of the moon program. The synergy between both characters is something to behold and you dont see this type of blend enough. Some might say its cliche but modern day cliche to me means it holds truth. A beautiful experience from start to finish.

author: SkepticalHarry
quote: Coming from a player like myself whos tops games are AC Origins, Odyssey, and Syndicate, worlds matter to me. Gameplay and story also matter to me with a huge world to go along with it. When a game gets most of these tallied, these are generally the experiences I chase and cherish. Crimson Desert has taken the AC Origins world, and multiplied it by 3 with things to do, mysteries to solve and exploration to achieve. Landscapes are better, and density per square gaming yard seems to be some of the best ive seen. For an eastern studio to come out and match the likes of Bethesda and prime Ubi, says alot for a first game!. Def gets hit hard by western critics for some reason and I honestly dont know why. This game need around 10 hours to cook, and then youl be hooked. Easy 9.5 in my books.

author: SkepticalHarry
quote: Beauitufl inside and out. Brought the nostalgia back to life and I thank nintendo for doing it in the best way possible. From upgraded physics engine to cinematics and character sequences, its exactly what we wanted. Gameplay has been overhauled which was much needed, and I think with how these new components have been added, on top of the smooth experience from a past gem, it parallels in review score if not slightly better!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: SkepticalHarry
quote: Some of if not the best boss battle non soul like action adventure oriental game Ive ever played. Completley takes the soul like platform and creates its own synergy of intense combat, amazing boss battles which opens up the game to its own unique feel and vibe. The amount of effort that went into battle physics you can feel through the controller and this game deserves all the hype that it gets. Judging steam reviews and player counts, it seems this is a universal judgment. Amazing for a first in the series. Will be following this studio.

author: SkepticalHarry
quote: I thought Kingdom come deliverance 2 finalized my opinion on game of the year despite being so early in the year. I think I might have been wrong despite the brilliance on both ends. You come across games sometimes that make you feel like a great book or movie. Completely engaged in the story where you forget to touch your popcorn. Clair Obscur is one of those games where you forget you bought the popcorn. Ive never been a huge fan of tactical turned based type RPGs. As much as i want to get engrossed in these beautiful worlds, TRPGS usually come with slow moving characters, and gameplay that always end up fading me out 10 hours in. Always happens. When I grabbed Clair Obscur I figured the same. Get lost in a beautiful fantasy world, give it a try and then fade out halfway through. Around 4 hours in I realized this wasnt the case and this piece of content was a homer. Ive always been a fan of arpgs, like elden ring, souls games, the recent Lies of P and Kingdom come deliverance 2. The more time I had with Clair Obscur, the more I realized it had some similarities with the games I like. The blocking and hybrid defense/being connected with your character during battle rather than just watching the sequence fully play out. This connected me so much more to the mechanics, compared to how other games have done previous. Aside from all this, the plot is what really did me in. The plot is so stellar, I was stuck in this peridicment of not wanting this experience to end but at the same time needing to get to end to find clarity. Another recollection I had while playing was The Order 1833. As much as the game wasnt mass loved, I had such a connection to the cinematic experience combined with the plot that I just couldn't put it down until I saw the end. Clair Obscur really hits all the notes that can spawn a masterpiece of entertainment. Its got the fiery plot, great characters, amazing backdrops and sceneries, and most importantly, that X factor developers only dream of having when trying to reach the public with material. Most of the time its a gamble in hoping something can strike an audience with mass appeal, and other times its just pure plain old talent. Complete synergy and cohesion between the team and devs working on this. This team deserves all the praise they get. They took me, someone who isnt the biggest fan of games like this, and turned me into someone who now understands why there is so much love for games like this. I guess I had to have this type of experience to feel what others have experienced in the past with TRPGS to truly understand what can be done, when all the notes get hit. The level of craftsmanship here and story telling is something on par with the likes of Harry potter or LOTR, its pretty darn close. The darkness in the background as friends try and pull through so they can hold off ultimate demise. This game is a 10 and Id say its partly groundbreaking, moving the stake forward and merging gamers who prefer one type of RPG into a whole.

author: SkepticalHarry
quote: Aside from graphical quality, which I believe could be better, overall the game plays great compared to previous bethesda games. Took me a little bit longer to get invested to that of similiar games bethesda has offered but once I got on a roll and got connected to my menu and characters, It's a complete blast. I assume alot of the people who are hating are just shills of some sort, as always. The game is a beautiful piece of art from all angles and its rocks the bethesda rpg style so well, just like it's Brothers skyrim and Oblivion. People do say its like Fallout 4 or Oblivion in space and yes it is that!. It's that and some more, so if you like these style of games with deep exploration and gameplay, this should be a perfect fit for you. However gameplay, bugs, and overally consistency with storytelling and lack of modern day maps and overall QC has been downgraded from the typical Bethesda release which docks a few points off.

author: SkepticalHarry
quote: I'm another early 2000s N64/Xbox/Halo guy who never really experienced top down games or never thought it would peak my interests. It was always fps and third person shooters. After hearing about this game through the decreasing population of Diablo 4 and its lack of Endgame, I needed anything to fill the void. I ended up buying this with my brother and it's been one of the most unique experiences in gaming I've ever had in my 20 years. The strategy and chess mindset involved is something I never thought a game could be. If you don't plot your moves and turns right, the game gets pretty demanding and challenging, which is a great thing. The challenge is there, the soundtrack is beautiful (think Fable, Kingdoms of Amalur), the graphics are beautiful in they're own comfortable way, similiar to that of Diablo 4 or Path or Exile (I personally love that style). Last but not least the gameplay and story both sit way above water and Id give them both a 9. On top of all the other attributes this game brings to the table, along with such a custom and unique path and dialogue system, this game gets a 10. The last time I gave a 10 to a game was Uncharted 4 so this says something. To all fps guys who never really tried something like this. Give it a try and sit with it for a few hours.
